intro: Voice Relay sends selected normalized events through one approved Streamer.bot Speaker.bot action. It is disabled by default, strips links/control characters, applies local blocked terms, and retains no speech history.

sections.title: 1. Speaker.bot setup
sections.notice: Connect Speaker.bot inside Streamer.bot, import Voice Relay, approve Speak, then test a harmless phrase before enabling.

sections.title: 2. What may be spoken
sections.notice: Public chat is excluded by default. If enabled, start with broadcaster/moderator roles only.

sections.title: 4. Emergency controls
sections.notice: Pause/Resume/Stop controls affect new StreamBridge requests. Use Speaker.bot's native Clear Pending or Stop Speaking control to immediately clear speech already queued inside Speaker.bot.
